args: p_account uuid, p_query text, p_offset integer, p_limit integer, p_responses_only boolean
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.icash_workspace_opportunities(p_account uuid, p_query text DEFAULT ''::text, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0, p_limit integer DEFAULT 7, p_responses_only boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, state text, result jsonb, completed_at timestamp with time zone, engagement jsonb)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select s.id,s.state,s.result,s.completed_at,jsonb_build_object('responded',coalesce(o.responded,false),'interested',coalesce(o.interested,false),'optedOut',coalesce(o.opted_out,false)) from public.icash_screening_jobs s left join public.icash_opportunity_outcomes o on o.screening_id=s.id and o.account_id=s.account_id
 where s.account_id=p_account and s.state='complete'
  and (not p_responses_only or coalesce(o.responded,false) or coalesce(o.purchase_signed,false))
  and (p_query='' or position(lower(p_query) in lower(s.result->'property'->>'address'))>0)
 order by coalesce(o.purchase_signed,false) desc,coalesce(o.interested and not o.opted_out,false) desc,coalesce(o.responded,false) desc,o.response_at desc nulls last,s.created_at desc,s.id desc
 limit greatest(1,least(25,p_limit)) offset greatest(0,least(60000,p_offset));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.icash_outbound_search_due(p_account uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select public.icash_prospecting_available(p_account)>=r.charge_cents and public.icash_search_due_before_prospecting_budget(p_account)
 from public.icash_discovery_configs c join public.icash_operation_rates r on r.id=c.rate_id where c.account_id=p_account;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.icash_enrichment_candidate(p_account uuid)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select public.icash_enrichment_before_prospecting_budget(p_account) from public.icash_discovery_configs c
 join public.icash_operation_rates r on r.id=c.contact_rate_id where c.account_id=p_account and public.icash_prospecting_available(p_account)>=r.charge_cents;
$function$

args: p_balance bigint, p_started timestamp with time zone
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.icash_prospecting_released(p_balance bigint, p_started timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 with cap as (select greatest(0,p_balance/2) total),
 starter as (select total,least(p_balance/4,greatest(500,ceil(total/10.0))) initial from cap)
 select (initial+floor((total-initial)*least(1,greatest(0,extract(epoch from (now()-p_started))/(24*3600)))))::bigint from starter;
$function$

definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.icash_workspace_ready_opportunities(p_account uuid, p_query text DEFAULT ''::text, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0, p_limit integer DEFAULT 7)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, state text, result jsonb, completed_at timestamp with time zone, engagement jsonb)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select s.id,s.state,s.result,s.completed_at,
  jsonb_build_object('responded',coalesce(o.responded,false),'interested',coalesce(o.interested,false),'optedOut',coalesce(o.opted_out,false))
 from public.icash_screening_jobs s
 left join public.icash_opportunity_outcomes o on o.screening_id=s.id and o.account_id=s.account_id
 where s.account_id=p_account and s.state='complete' and coalesce(s.snapshot->>'practice','false')<>'true'
  and (coalesce(o.responded,false) or coalesce(o.purchase_signed,false) or (
   s.result->'financialCheck'->>'status'='eligible' and s.snapshot->>'propertyType'='house'
   and not coalesce(o.opted_out,false)
   and s.snapshot->>'propertyId'=s.result->'property'->>'propertyId'
   and s.completed_at between now()-interval '24 hours' and now()
   and case when pg_catalog.pg_input_is_valid(s.snapshot->>'fetchedAt','timestamp with time zone')
    then (s.snapshot->>'fetchedAt')::timestamptz between now()-interval '24 hours' and now() else false end))
  and (p_query='' or position(lower(p_query) in lower(s.result->'property'->>'address'))>0)
 order by coalesce(o.purchase_signed,false) desc,coalesce(o.interested and not o.opted_out,false) desc,
  coalesce(o.responded,false) desc,o.response_at desc nulls last,s.created_at desc,s.id desc
 limit greatest(1,least(25,p_limit)) offset greatest(0,least(60000,p_offset));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.icash_prospecting_available(p_account uuid)
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 with budget as (select * from public.icash_prospecting_budgets where account_id=p_account order by id desc limit 1),
 usage as (select
  coalesce(sum(case when o.state='settled' and (o.prospecting_budget_id=b.id or (o.prospecting_budget_id is not null and o.settled_at>now()-interval '24 hours')) then o.charged_cents
   when o.state in ('reserved','dispatched') and (o.prospecting_budget_id is not null or public.icash_new_prospect_operation(p_account,o.operation_key,o.rate_id)) then o.charge_cap_cents else 0 end),0) amount,
  coalesce(sum(case when o.state='settled' and o.prospecting_budget_id is not null and o.settled_at>now()-interval '24 hours' then o.charged_cents
   when o.state in ('reserved','dispatched') and (o.prospecting_budget_id is not null or public.icash_new_prospect_operation(p_account,o.operation_key,o.rate_id)) then o.charge_cap_cents else 0 end),0) recent_amount,
  coalesce(sum(case when o.state='settled' and o.prospecting_budget_id is not null and o.settled_at>now()-interval '1 hour' then o.charged_cents
   when o.state in ('reserved','dispatched') and (o.prospecting_budget_id is not null or public.icash_new_prospect_operation(p_account,o.operation_key,o.rate_id)) then o.charge_cap_cents else 0 end),0) hour_amount
  from public.icash_operation_spend o cross join budget b where o.account_id=p_account)
 select coalesce((select greatest(0,least(
  public.icash_prospecting_total_available(p_account),
  public.icash_prospecting_released(b.baseline_cents,b.created_at)-usage.amount,
  b.baseline_cents/4-usage.recent_amount,
  least(b.baseline_cents/4,greatest(500,ceil(b.limit_cents/10.0)))-usage.hour_amount
 ))::bigint from budget b cross join usage),0);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.icash_activate_auto_recharge(p_order uuid, p_customer text, p_method text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare o public.icash_funding_orders;
begin
 select * into strict o from public.icash_funding_orders where id=p_order;
 if not o.auto_recharge or o.state<>'paid' or o.credited_at is null or p_customer !~ '^cus_[A-Za-z0-9]+$' or p_method !~ '^pm_[A-Za-z0-9]+$'
 or not exists(select 1 from public.icash_funding_consents where order_id=o.id and version in ('work-credits-2026-10-06.1:recharge-2026-10-06.1','work-credits-2026-10-07.1:recharge-2026-10-06.1','work-credits-2026-10-10.1:recharge-2026-10-10.1','work-credits-2026-10-20.1:recharge-2026-10-10.1') and price_cents=o.price_cents and account_id=o.account_id)
 then raise exception 'Unverified auto recharge authorization';end if;
 update public.icash_auto_recharges set enabled=true,approved_order=o.id,pending_order=null,amount_cents=o.price_cents,stripe_customer_id=p_customer,stripe_payment_method_id=p_method,issue=null,updated_at=now()
 where account_id=o.account_id and mode=o.mode and pending_order=o.id;
end $function$
